parameter.label: Requests
parameter.tooltip: JSON array of {id, calendar, fromDate, amount, unit, direction, adjust, time, dependsOn}. calendar is a calendar Name or ID (blank uses the default). fromDate is YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 datetime with an offset. unit is business_days, calendar_days, weeks or business_hours; direction after or before; adjust none, previous_business_day or next_business_day; time HH:MM or null. dependsOn is the id of another request whose result datetime is the From Date when fromDate is blank. At most 1000 requests.

result.name: Dates
result.tooltip: JSON object keyed by request id: {date, datetime} with datetime in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ), or {error}.

result.name: Error Count
result.tooltip: How many requests could not be calculated.

result.name: Error Code
result.tooltip: Blank unless the batch as a whole failed, e.g. Requests is not a JSON array (INVALID_ARGUMENT) or has too many requests (LIMIT_EXCEEDED). Then Dates is empty.

result.name: Error Message
result.tooltip: Blank unless the batch as a whole failed.
